Hi team — update from Platform after audit. Root cause: a SAML NameID collision combined with case-insensitive email normalization. A previous invite was claimed by a user whose email had mixed-case (Samantha.Li@OrionMed.com) and our claim index normalized to lower-case, which created a shadow/duplicate mapping that displayed the other address on the acceptance page.

Actions taken:
- Performed a tenant rebind for Orion (tenant id OR-45321) and cleared the stale claim entry.
- Deployed a short rollback-safe migration to keep future claim keys case-preserving in the index (we will follow up with a prod patch next week).
- Uploaded the investigation log: rebind-log-2029-07-22.txt (attached).

Samantha — can you please try the original portal invite link again and confirm you can accept and upload your W-9? If you still see issues, reply with the trace id and we’ll pick up immediately.

We also confirmed the temporary manual activation token issued by Ben was valid and did allow onboarding; however, we prefer you accept the original invite so the tenant mapping stays consistent.

Thanks,
